name: Crepes
desc: Thin French crepes for sweet or savory fillings.

source.title: Basic Crêpes
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (1 cup flour, 2 eggs, 1/2 cup each milk and water, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tbsp melted butter) and the same 1/4 cup pour and swirl.

ingredients.raw: 1 tsp vegetable oil, for the pan

steps: Whisk together the flour and eggs. Gradually whisk in the milk and water. Add the salt and melted butter and whisk until smooth and pourable.
Heat an 8- to 10-inch skillet or crepe pan over medium-high heat and wipe it lightly with oil.
Pour in about 1/4 cup batter and immediately tilt and swirl the pan so it coats the bottom in a thin, even layer.
Cook until the top is no longer wet and the bottom is light brown, 1 to 2 minutes. Loosen the edge with a spatula, flip, and cook until the second side is light brown, about 1 minute more. Serve hot.
tips: Makes about 8 crepes. Stack finished crepes on a plate under a towel to keep them soft.

references.title: Basic Crêpes
references.usedFor: 1 to 2 minute and 1 minute cook times, loosening the edge before flipping, yield of 8
